title: Kamailio v5.8.8 Released
html:
Kamailio SIP Server v5.8.8 stable is out – a minor release including fixes in code and documentation since v5.8.7. The configuration file and database schema compatibility is preserved, which means you don’t have to change anything to update.

Kamailio® v5.8.8 is based on the latest source code of GIT branch 5.8 and it represents the latest stable version. We recommend those running previous 5.8.x or older versions to upgrade. There is no change that has to be done to configuration file or database structure comparing with the previous releases of the v5.8 branch.

Resources for Kamailio version 5.8.8

Source tarballs are available at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/pub/kamailio/5.8.8/src/

Detailed changelog:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/pub/kamailio/5.8.8/ChangeLog

Download via GIT:

 # git clone https://github.com/kamailio/kamailio kamailio
 # cd kamailio
 # git checkout -b 5.8 origin/5.8

Relevant notes, binaries and packages will be uploaded at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/pub/kamailio/5.8.8/

Modules’ documentation:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/docs/modules/5.8.x/

What is new in 5.8.x release series is summarized in the announcement of v5.8.0:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/w/kamailio-v5-8-0-release-notes/

Note that 5.8.x is currently the third last stable release series, the latest is 6.1.x and v6.1.1 was released on Mar 4, 2026. The v5.8.8 is the last release planned in the 5.8.x series.

Note also the dates of next Kamailio World Conference: May 7-8, 2026, to be organized again in Berlin, Germany. More details about the event at:

  • https://www.kamailioworld.com

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
